hypothesis: short family-adapted no-op notices improve completion against current feedback without weakening activation or paired cost gates

notice_text.aya_direct: [loop] Repeated tool call skipped. Choose a different action or give the final answer now.
notice_text.mistral_use: [loop] Repeated call skipped. Use the existing result: answer now, or change the tool arguments.
notice_text.gemma_choice: [loop] Repeated call skipped. Output one different JSON tool call or the final answer; do not repeat.

candidate_hypotheses.aya_direct: A direct positive choice between a different action and an immediate answer increases useful redirects for Aya.
candidate_hypotheses.mistral_use: Explicitly telling Mistral to reuse the existing result turns its already high redirect rate into final answers.
candidate_hypotheses.gemma_choice: An explicit JSON-tool-call-or-final-answer choice increases Gemma response to repeat suppression.
